description: FR-HR-003 -- an employee's request to consume a leave balance.

fields.label: Leave Type
fields.description: Which balance is being drawn on.

fields.label: Half Day
fields.description: Counts the leave as half a day. Only meaningful on a single-day application.

fields.label: Business Status
fields.options:
Draft
Pending Approval
Approved
Rejected
Cancelled
fields.description: Where this document has got to. Moved with the buttons at the top of this form, never typed.

fields.label: Holiday List
fields.description: The calendar whose days are skipped. Taken from the leave period when left blank.

fields.label: Total Leave Days
fields.description: Working days between the two dates, after skipping holidays. Computed, never typed.

fields.label: Balance Before This Application
fields.description: The balance when this application was last saved. A record of what was checked, not a live figure.

fields.label: Posting Date
fields.description: The date the application was made.

fields.label: Leave Approver
fields.description: Who is to decide. Approval routing is not built; this records the intended approver.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Why the leave is being taken.

name: KNIT 360 Leave Application
